title: Head of Scaled, Ads Solutions
description: About the Team OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. In support of that mission, the Ads Solutions team partners closely with advertisers, agencies, and strategic partners to help businesses unlock value through AI-powered advertising solutions while maintaining strong standards for user trust, platform integrity, and responsible innovation. As OpenAI’s advertising business scales, the Head of ScaledAds Sales will build the strategy and operating system for serving businesses at global scale. This leader will connect direct, reseller, and outsourced channels; turn market priorities into execution; and shape a repeatable growth model that protects advertiser outcomes and user trust. This role reports directly to the VP of Global Ads Solutions and will be a key member of their leadership team. About the Role We are seeking a Head of Scaled Ads Sales to define and scale OpenAI’s approach to serving advertisers at scale. You will set the scaled sales strategy across direct, reseller, and business-process-outsourcing (BPO) channels; identify priority markets; and translate that strategy into sequenced, measurable in-market execution. This is a highly strategic and operational leadership role responsible for scaled sales revenue growth and channel performance. You will design the reseller model, select priority vendors and markets, lead RFPs and contracting, and manage partners against clear commercial and customer-quality standards. You will also work closely with outsourced vendors in the BPO channel and test a focused mid-market sales team as a potential growth engine. The ideal candidate combines scaled go-to-market strategy, channel leadership, vendor-management discipline, experimentation, and operational rigor. You are equally comfortable building a business case, running an RFP, coaching internal and partner teams, reviewing funnel economics, and changing course quickly when market evidence challenges the plan. The role location and office expectations will be determined in partnership with the hiring team. In this role you will: Design, build, coach and develop the scaled sales organization and its partner ecosystem, fostering a high-performance, accountable, and customer-centric culture. Set OpenAI’s scaled ads sales strategy across direct, reseller and BPO, channels, including segmentation, geographic coverage, and channel selection. Own scaled sales (including resellers) revenue goals and channel performance, with clear targets for acquisition, activation, retention, advertiser outcomes, and partner performance. Translate strategy into prioritized in-market action and launch plans, documenting owners, milestones, and operating reviews that accelerate advertiser adoption, retention, and expansion. Partner with Enterprise Sales, GTM, Marketing, Product, and Operations leaders to optimize the advertiser lifecycle from acquisition through activation, growth, and retention. Design and run reseller operations, including market and vendor selection, RFPs, commercial negotiations, onboarding, enablement, governance, and ongoing performance management. Build forecasting, funnel management, capacity planning, partner scorecards, and business reviews that create operational excellence and predictable growth. Serve as the voice of scaled advertisers and channel partners, bringing market insight and customer feedback to Product, Engineering, and leadership teams. Represent OpenAI at industry events, with media, and in the field to advocate for our mission and growth. Collaborate with outsourced vendors in the BPO channel to define scope, training, quality standards, incentives, compliance, and continuous improvement. Launch and evaluate a focused mid-market team experiment, defining the hypothesis, account selection, coverage model, success metrics, and criteria to scale, iterate, or stop. Establish scalable processes, playbooks, controls, and best practices that support responsible growth across markets, channels, and customer segments. You might thrive in this role if you: Have 15+ years of experience in digital advertising, media, technology, or related commercial leadership roles. Have 10+ years of experience leading high-performing scaled sales, account management, customer success, or revenue teams. Are experienced in building new products from the ground up, and comfortable in a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment. Are passionate and energized by the new possibilities of AI being applied to marketing, and have strong desire to play a role in shaping that future. Have a proven track record of exceeding revenue targets and scaling performance-advertising businesses across multiple channels and markets. Have deep experience with reseller and outsourced sales operations, including vendor selection, RFPs, contracting, onboarding, enablement, governance, and performance management. Are an exceptional people leader who enjoys recruiting, coaching, developing, and inspiring teams to achieve ambitious goals. Can build strong relationships with reseller executives, BPO leaders, advertisers, and senior internal decision-makers. Can turn strategy into prioritized market actions, explicit owners, measurable milestones, and a disciplined operating cadence. Are highly data-driven and comfortable using funnel metrics, unit economics, service quality, and experimentation to prioritize investments and drive accountability. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement . In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. title: Senior Product Security Engineer
description: About Numan Founded in 2018, we’ve already grown to be a 300+ team distributed across the globe, united by a singular mission: empowering people to take control of their health. Numan is transforming health: we’ve built a cutting-edge platform that integrates diagnostics, medication, supplements, digital programmes, and doctor consultations. Giving people the tools they need to maximise life. To deliver on our transformative mission, we are guided by our 5 company values: • Patients first. • Learn fast. • Own the quality. • Succeed together. • Care deeply. Backed by top-tier investors, Numan is already having a positive impact on hundreds of thousands of patients here in the UK, and we want you to help us deliver this mission! The Role We build and operate a regulated digital health platform. Patients trust us with clinical data, identity documents and payment details, and our clinicians trust our systems to be correct. That makes application security a patient safety concern, not just a compliance one. We are shipping quickly, adopting AI and agentic systems across clinical operations and patient-facing products, and running a lean security function that scales through engineering leverage rather than headcount. We need a senior engineer who can go deep on design and code, then bring the rest of the business along with them. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with genuine influence over how the platform is built. The Team You will work within the Cyber Security function, collaborating directly with Engineering, Product, Clinical, Legal, and the executive team. Security at Numan is not a gatekeeping function — it scales through influence, credibility, and being useful early. You'll be: Running threat modelling sessions with product and engineering teams on new features and architectural changes — STRIDE-based, with clinical safety, abuse, and business-logic threats kept in mind alongside the technical ones. Owning and evolving our Secure by Design process: self-evaluation screening, secure design review, and the threat modelling pathway, including our use of automated tooling against technical artefacts. Turning threat models into tracked, prioritised controls that engineering teams actually implement. Pushing design decisions upstream so the cheap fix is designed in rather than the expensive one retrofitted. Assessing and securing AI systems in production: LLM-backed features, retrieval pipelines, agentic workflows, tool-calling integrations, and the MCP and API surfaces that connect them. Building practical threat models and controls for agent-specific failure modes — prompt injection, tool misuse, excessive agency, data exfiltration through context, unsafe autonomy, and supply chain risk in model and plugin ecosystems. Performing automated application and API penetration testing against our own products — web, mobile backends, cloud-native services on GCP, internal tooling, and AI features. Leading penetration engagements with third parties and working on the fix with engineering. Chaining findings into realistic attack paths and demonstrating impact, rather than delivering a list of scanner output. Embedding security into our pipelines: SAST, SCA, secrets detection, IaC scanning, container and dependency hygiene — tuned so signal beats noise and engineers trust the gates. Working with platform and engineering to raise baseline standards: authentication and authorisation patterns, secrets management, tenancy isolation, and logging and detection coverage. Actively participating in the security community — OWASP chapters or projects, local meetups, CTFs, research groups — and publishing research, write-ups, or blog posts under your own name. We're looking for someone who: Brings substantial hands-on application security experience in a product engineering environment, at senior level. Has demonstrable threat modelling practice — not just familiarity with the theory. Has practical offensive skills against modern web and API stacks, with an appropriate certification or equivalent demonstrable experience (OSCP, OSWE, CREST, Burp Suite Certified Practitioner or similar). Is comfortable reading and reasoning about code in at least one language used in production systems, and can review a pull request meaningfully. Has working knowledge of cloud-native architecture and its security model — ideally GCP, but AWS or Azure experience transfers. Has experience integrating security tooling into CI/CD, and the scars to know what makes engineers ignore it. Has a track record of shipping security improvements through other teams. Has experience securing AI or agentic systems in production. Has hands-on experience securing Kubernetes environments and managing cloud security posture using CNAPP and CSPM solutions, with a primary focus on GCP but AWS and Azure experience is translatable. raw.description:
About Numan 
 
Founded in 2018, we’ve already grown to be a 300+ team distributed across the globe, united by a singular mission: empowering people to take control of their health.
 
Numan is transforming health: we’ve built a cutting-edge platform that integrates diagnostics, medication, supplements, digital programmes, and doctor consultations. Giving people the tools they need to maximise life.
 
To deliver on our transformative mission, we are guided by our 5 company values: 
 
• Patients first.
• Learn fast.
• Own the quality.
• Succeed together.
• Care deeply.
 
Backed by top-tier investors, Numan is already having a positive impact on hundreds of thousands of patients here in the UK, and we want you to help us deliver this mission!

The Role

We build and operate a regulated digital health platform. Patients trust us with clinical data, identity documents and payment details, and our clinicians trust our systems to be correct. That makes application security a patient safety concern, not just a compliance one.

We are shipping quickly, adopting AI and agentic systems across clinical operations and patient-facing products, and running a lean security function that scales through engineering leverage rather than headcount. We need a senior engineer who can go deep on design and code, then bring the rest of the business along with them.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with genuine influence over how the platform is built.

The Team

You will work within the Cyber Security function, collaborating directly with Engineering, Product, Clinical, Legal, and the executive team. Security at Numan is not a gatekeeping function — it scales through influence, credibility, and being useful early.


You'll be:

  • Running threat modelling sessions with product and engineering teams on new features and architectural changes — STRIDE-based, with clinical safety, abuse, and business-logic threats kept in mind alongside the technical ones.

  • Owning and evolving our Secure by Design process: self-evaluation screening, secure design review, and the threat modelling pathway, including our use of automated tooling against technical artefacts.

  • Turning threat models into tracked, prioritised controls that engineering teams actually implement.

  • Pushing design decisions upstream so the cheap fix is designed in rather than the expensive one retrofitted.

  • Assessing and securing AI systems in production: LLM-backed features, retrieval pipelines, agentic workflows, tool-calling integrations, and the MCP and API surfaces that connect them.

  • Building practical threat models and controls for agent-specific failure modes — prompt injection, tool misuse, excessive agency, data exfiltration through context, unsafe autonomy, and supply chain risk in model and plugin ecosystems.

  • Performing automated application and API penetration testing against our own products — web, mobile backends, cloud-native services on GCP, internal tooling, and AI features.

  • Leading penetration engagements with third parties and working on the fix with engineering.

  • Chaining findings into realistic attack paths and demonstrating impact, rather than delivering a list of scanner output.

  • Embedding security into our pipelines: SAST, SCA, secrets detection, IaC scanning, container and dependency hygiene — tuned so signal beats noise and engineers trust the gates.

  • Working with platform and engineering to raise baseline standards: authentication and authorisation patterns, secrets management, tenancy isolation, and logging and detection coverage.

  • Actively participating in the security community — OWASP chapters or projects, local meetups, CTFs, research groups — and publishing research, write-ups, or blog posts under your own name.


    • We're looking for someone who:

  • Brings substantial hands-on application security experience in a product engineering environment, at senior level.

  • Has demonstrable threat modelling practice — not just familiarity with the theory.

  • Has practical offensive skills against modern web and API stacks, with an appropriate certification or equivalent demonstrable experience (OSCP, OSWE, CREST, Burp Suite Certified Practitioner or similar).

  • Has working knowledge of cloud-native architecture and its security model — ideally GCP, but AWS or Azure experience transfers.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
About Emplifi

Emplifi is the only Autonomous CX platform unifying social marketing, commerce, and customer care for more than 20,000 brands worldwide. Powered by Fuel AI, built on more than 5T of data, and recognized as a leader by leading industry analysts, Emplifi helps enterprise teams orchestrate connected customer journeys and deliver personalized experiences at scale, turning every customer touchpoint into a competitive advantage.

About Emplifi

Emplifi is the only Autonomous CX platform unifying social marketing, commerce, and customer care for more than 20,000 brands worldwide. Powered by Fuel AI, built on more than 5T of data, and recognized as a leader by leading industry analysts, Emplifi helps enterprise teams orchestrate connected customer journeys and deliver personalized experiences at scale, turning every customer touchpoint into a competitive advantage.


About the Product Team 

At Emplifi, our mission is to transform how digital marketing—especially on social—is done, and how consumers connect with brands in the 21st century.

Our Product team sits at the heart of this mission. We build and evolve a data-driven SaaS platform that helps global enterprises market smarter. By bridging customer needs, business goals, and technical innovation, we break down silos, foster collaboration, and use insights to guide smart, impactful decisions.


About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced, data-driven Senior Product Manager to shape the future of Emplifi’s Data Insights capabilities — a core product area that enables brands to understand conversations, uncover emerging topics, and act on market signals that matter most.

This is about building intelligence that helps brands understand what people care about, how perceptions evolve, and where opportunities arise across digital channels. You’ll be leading a product area that helps marketers and strategists collect the right data and turn them into actionable insight—at scale.

You’ll own the roadmap, vision, and execution for this strategic capability, partnering closely with design, engineering, data science, and go-to-market teams to create powerful, intuitive experiences for enterprise users. This includes managing integrations with external data providers to ensure scalable, high-quality access to insights.

This position is remote/hybrid from within the Czech Republic, the UK, France, or Germany. 



Why This Role Matters

In today’s world, tracking discourse, sentiment, and context across digital sources gives brands a competitive edge. Organizations that move fast to uncover trends, surface risks, and respond to emergent feedback win. You’ll lead a product at the intersection of data, AI, and strategy helping the world’s leading brands stay in tune with conversations, perceptions, and signals that shape their markets.

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Is passionate about turning complex, unstructured data into clear insight and action.
  • Understands how enterprise marketers, analysts, and strategists use insights to guide decisions.
  • Can translate business challenges into scalable, data-driven solutions powered by AI and analytics.
  • Thrives in a space where technology, storytelling, and customer empathy meet.

What You’ll Do Here

  • Own the vision and roadmap for one of the Data Insights product line — setting direction based on customer needs, market dynamics, and company goals.
  • Drive product discovery - talking to customers (brands and retailers), observing behavior, synthesizing data, and identifying unmet needs and opportunities.
  • Translate ideas into execution - write clear requirements, work with design and engineering, and iterate fast to deliver impactful, high-quality solutions.
  • Be a market expert - understand the competitive landscape and adjacent categories, monitor trends in ecommerce and AI, and translate them into product strategy.
  • Manage data partnerships and integrations - oversee connections with third-party data providers and APIs, ensuring consistent, reliable data access. Evaluate vendor performance, react quickly to API or data schema changes, and balance product impact against integration costs.
  • Partner cross-functionally - collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Leadership to position the product for success across the customer lifecycle.
  • Measure what matters - define success metrics, analyze outcomes, and refine based on learnings to ensure continuous improvement and customer value.


What You’ll Bring to Us

  • 3+ years of experience in Product Management, ideally in B2B SaaS
  • Track record of product impact – You’ve successfully led products through key stages of their lifecycle, whether taking over complex existing solutions or driving new launches, and can demonstrate how you improved outcomes and measured results.
  • Deep familiarity with AI in practice — you actively use AI tools to enhance your workflow and have experience defining, delivering, and iterating on AI-powered features that create tangible value for users.
  • High autonomy & maturity – You’re ready to own a product stream within your first 90 days, defining strategy, uncovering new problems, and driving delivery without hand-holding.
  • Global mindset – Comfortable collaborating with colleagues and customers across time zones and cultures.
  • Agile mindset – Experienced in iterative releases, and data-driven optimisation.
  • Technical fluency & AI awareness – You can talk architecture with engineers, understand how complex distributed systems fit together, and spot opportunities to apply the latest AI/ML advances to solve customer problems.
  • Fluent, persuasive communicator – You write, present, and negotiate confidently in English while actively listening, distilling insights, persuading stakeholders, and selling product value.
  • Proactive problem-solver – You spot issues, rally the right people, and deliver solutions. No waiting for task lists.

BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with managing products that rely on external or third-party data sources. Comfortable analyzing ROI, negotiating data costs, and adapting quickly to changes in API availability or pricing.
  • Experience with analytics, data visualization, or insight-generation tools
  • Background in social media, audience research, or digital strategy
  • Passion for empowering organizations to make smarter, faster, data-driven decisions

What We Offer 

  • International and fast-paced environment
  • Chance to work with the world’s biggest brands at the CX tech leader
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off
  • Sick Days & Community Service Days
  • Multisport card
  • Maternity and Parental Benefit
  • Agile and open-minded culture, with high levels of trust and flexibility
  • Opportunity for professional growth and development
  • Possibility to learn new and cutting-edge technologies, in an environment that encourages new ideas
  • AI-first workplace, with access to leading AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and more), empowering you to work smarter, innovate faster, and build AI skills for the future
  • Flexible working environment
  • Work in an international environment in our modern offices in Karlín, with our big terrace and our own grill
  • There’s more as well! Speak with us to find out all the details!

 

At Emplifi, we are committed to creating a workplace where everyone is valued, respected, and empowered to bring their whole selves to work. We welcome applications from individuals of all ages, races, religions, genders, sexual orientations, gender identities, and LGBTQ+ communities.

Emplifi offers a safe, inclusive, and supportive environment where every employee has the opportunity to thrive and is encouraged to be who they are.

title: VP/Head of Engineering (all genders)
description: Your mission Full technical ownership of Rocket — reporting directly to the founders, with no layer in between In this role you own engineering at MICE DESK — fully. There is no CTO layer above you: architecture, technology, delivery, and team are yours, and you report directly to the founders. This is a hands-on leadership role. You lead the engineering team including our AI/Data function, own the interface to Product, and are accountable for everything that ships. Engineering, end-to-end. Architecture, system design, delivery against the roadmap, reliability, technical debt. Backend, frontend, DevOps, QA, and the AI/Data team all roll up to you. You set lightweight processes that let a small team ship fast without breaking things. An AI-enabled engineering pipeline. We don't just build AI products — we build with AI. You make the engineering organization itself AI-native: agentic coding workflows, AI-assisted review and testing, automation of everything repetitive. A small team should ship like one three times its size — making that true is your job. AI as a core system capability. You architect the integration of LLMs and agentic workflows into production systems: deterministic logic combined with AI-generated outputs, with real validation, fallbacks, and reliability strategies. Hotel operations run on our platform — non-determinism is no excuse for unreliability. The team. Hire, mentor, scale. You inherit a strong small team and grow it into a high-performance engineering organization with a culture of ownership and speed. Our distributed hiring strategy across multiple locations is yours as well. Product and business alignment. You work directly with the founders and Product. You challenge requirements, simplify complexity, and connect engineering work to outcomes: revenue, automation, customer impact. As we enter the US market, engineering has to keep pace with enterprise-scale customers on two continents. What success looks like: 6 months: Delivery is predictable, the AI-enabled dev pipeline is running, and the team has grown with A-players you hired. 12 months: The platform scales with US enterprise customers, core systems are reliable and observable, and engineering is a competitive advantage — not a bottleneck. Honestly: This is full accountability with no net above it. No CTO layer to make or catch decisions — the architecture, the team, and everything that ships are yours. If you want a role where someone above you sets direction, this isn't it. If you want exactly that ownership, it is. Your profile 10+ years of software engineering, 5+ in an engineering leadership role at high-growth product companies. Strong hands-on backend or full-stack background — you can still go deep. Proven experience scaling engineering teams at growing startups. Strong architecture expertise: APIs, distributed systems, event-driven design, cloud. We operate at the critical intersection of software development and system safety, ensuring every release meets the highest performance and reliability standards. You will work closely with cross-functional partners in sofware & hardware, and flight operations to maintain technical integrity in a fast-paced environment.


Your mission

As the Software IVV Lead, you will act as the independent software testing and verification authority, ensuring that the standards defined by our architecture are measurably adhered to, rigorously tested, and successfully audited. You will own the strategy, infrastructure, and execution of software validation and verification, serving as the ultimate quality gatekeeper for our software release candidates before they reach hardware integration and testing in the field.


Responsibilities

  • Define the Test Strategy: Establish and enforce the overarching software testing frameworks and QA processes (based on ISTQB) across all software capability teams.

  • Manage Test Infrastructure & Tooling: Oversee the setup and maintenance of software test environments and test data, ensure the qualification of testing tools, and lead the generation of audit-proof, revision-safe test evidence.

Define and monitor the traceability processes in close collaboration with Software Configuration Management (SCM), ensuring operational compliance.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
At Too Good To Go, we dream of a planet with no food waste.

Did you know that more than 40% of all food produced gets thrown away? This unnecessary food waste — and the resources needed to produce and transport it — accounts for 10% of global greenhouse gas emissions.

Too Good To Go is a certified B Corporation on a mission to end food waste. We connect stores with surplus food to consumers across 20 markets in Europe, North America, and APAC — with over 140 million registered users, more than 200,000 daily active stores, and 600 million meals saved from going to waste.

Why This Role

Pricing sits at the centre of everything we do. It shapes what partners earn, what consumers pay, and how much surplus food actually gets saved. Today, pricing decisions are made in different places, for different reasons, without a single team owning the strategy end to end.

We are changing that. We are building our first dedicated Pricing team — and you will be the founding member.

You will start with a concrete, high-value problem: the pricing infrastructure behind our Key Account deals. That's your launchpad — from there, you will have real scope to shape our approach to dynamic pricing, consumer-facing service fees, and pricing strategy across Too Good To Go more broadly. This is a role built for someone who wants to define a domain, not just execute a brief.

The goal behind everything we do is twofold: save as much surplus food as possible, and grow the pie between TGTG, our Partners, and our Consumers — never trading one off against the other.

There is a further dimension to this. We are expanding beyond food into new non-food, non-perishable categories — and that growth brings pricing complexity and opportunity we have not had to solve before. Getting ahead of that, rather than reacting to it, is part of this role.

Your Mission

As Senior Product Manager for Pricing, you will build the foundation for how Too Good To Go prices its marketplace — starting with Key Account deals, then extending across the business.

In the near term, you will design and ship the infrastructure that lets us set, manage, and evolve pricing for Key Account partnerships with the flexibility our commercial teams need. From there, you will develop a smarter, more dynamic pricing algorithm that responds to supply, demand, and partner economics — replacing static rules with something genuinely intelligent. Alongside this, you will investigate our consumer-facing service fees: how they're structured, how they're perceived, and where there is room to optimise.

Underneath all of it are two questions you will own: how do we price in a way that saves as much surplus food as possible, and how do we grow the pie for everyone — Too Good To Go, our Partners, and our Consumers — rather than shifting value from one side to another? Answering both well means understanding marketplace pricing broadly: the best practices and patterns other two- and three-sided marketplaces use, and what applies to ours.

Pricing decisions rarely stay inside one product's boundaries, so you will work across product teams and the wider organisation — Commercial, Data Science, Engineering, Finance, and Key Accounts — to make sure pricing is right everywhere it shows up, not just within your own roadmap. You will become the go-to person for anything pricing-related at Too Good To Go, including presenting your strategy and results to the Global Management Team.

You will also help lay the pricing groundwork for our move into non-food, non-perishable categories — different cost structures, margins, and purchase patterns than the food pricing we know today, and a chance to shape pricing thinking for a new part of the business from the start.

The Team

You will be the founding Pricing PM, operating as an individual contributor, with a small dedicated engineering team of around 3-4 developers to start. We will grow the team's scope and headcount as we prove impact, not before. You will report directly to our VP of Product.

This is a new team with a clear starting point, not a fixed script. You will know where to begin — Key Account deals — but how the team's remit, roadmap, and impact grow from there is largely yours to shape. If you want a role where everything is already solved and you are just executing, this isn't it. If you want to help define what great pricing looks like across Too Good To Go, it is.

The role is suited to someone who does not need daily direction — who can set the agenda within that mandate, manage up effectively, and make strong pricing calls with incomplete information.

Responsibilities

  • Build the pricing infrastructure for Key Account deals, giving commercial teams the tools and flexibility to structure partnerships well while keeping pricing logic sound and scalable.
  • Design and develop a smart pricing algorithm — moving from static, rules-based pricing toward a dynamic model informed by supply, demand, and partner-specific economics.
  • Investigate consumer-facing service fees: how they're set, how they perform, and how they should evolve to balance consumer value with business sustainability.
  • Take a holistic view of pricing across TGTG, Partners, and Consumers — optimising for meals saved and for growing the pie for all three, rather than trading one off against another.
  • Research and apply best practices and patterns from marketplace pricing more broadly, adapting proven approaches to our specific dynamics rather than reinventing from scratch.
  • Own the roadmap and OKRs for the Pricing team within its agreed mandate, sequencing the work so that early wins on Key Accounts build toward the algorithm and fee strategy.
  • Work across product teams and the wider organisation — Commercial, Data Science, Engineering, Finance, and Key Accounts — to make sure pricing decisions are right wherever they show up, not just within your own roadmap.
  • Be the go-to person for anything pricing-related at Too Good To Go, including presenting strategy, models, and results to the Global Management Team.
  • Anticipate the pricing complexity and opportunity of TGTG's expansion into non-food, non-perishable categories, and start laying the groundwork for pricing them well.
  • Use data rigorously — pricing experiments, elasticity analysis, partner and consumer feedback — to test hypotheses before scaling them.

What We Are Looking For

  • Multi-year experience in Product Management with direct, hands-on ownership of pricing.
  • Experience with pricing in a marketplace or platform business is a genuine differentiator. If you've worked on take rates, dynamic pricing, two-sided pricing trade-offs, or fee structures in a marketplace, you will hit the ground running.
  • A track record of building pricing algorithms, models, or infrastructure — not just adjusting numbers in a spreadsheet, but shipping systems that price things well and can evolve over time.
  • Comfort working with quantitative teams (data science, analytics, finance) to translate pricing theory into production systems.

How you work

  • You are comfortable — and genuinely thrive — working independently, with a high degree of autonomy, especially in the early stages of building a new team.
  • You bring a rigorous, quantitative mind. You reason from first principles about supply, demand, and incentives, and you back your recommendations with data and clear models.
  • You can hold multiple stakeholders' interests in view at once — TGTG's, our Partners', and our Consumers' — and make the case for a solution that works for all three.
  • You build genuine working relationships across product and the wider business, not just within your own team, so that pricing is done right wherever it touches the product.
  • You are an excellent communicator, comfortable presenting to senior and executive audiences — including the Global Management Team — with clarity and confidence.
  • You move fast. You do not wait for perfect information. You are decisive, transparent about your reasoning, and quick to adjust.
  • You have a growth mindset. You are always looking for the next level — in the pricing model, in the strategy, and in yourself.
  • You are genuinely fun to work with. You bring your authentic self, you care about the mission, and you know how to succeed as part of a team.

Our Values

  • We win together: food waste is a big beast to fight. We can do it if we win together as Waste Warriors with no ego. We believe in #oneteam.
  • We raise the bar: we always push for more. We work smart, smash barriers, and elevate one another.
  • We keep it simple: our ambitions are bold but our solutions are simple.
  • We build a legacy: we are proud of the change we are driving.
  • We care: we always look out for each other. Caring is also about the way we do business. We do the right thing.

What We Have to Offer

  • A rare opportunity to work in a social impact company (and certified B Corporation!) where you get to wake up every day knowing you are achieving positive change.
  • The chance to build something genuinely new — a first-of-its-kind Pricing team, with a clear mandate and real influence over how the business grows.
  • Ownership over decisions that touch every side of our marketplace, from Key Account partnerships to millions of consumers.
  • The experience of being part of an international company with 1,200+ enthusiastic and highly talented teammates across 22 countries — always ready to share knowledge and support.
  • Strong personal and professional development in an intense and high-growth scale-up environment.
  • An open company culture where you have the independence and room to unleash your creativity.
  • A strong team culture where successes are celebrated together.

How to Apply

We take recruitment very seriously, so please carefully read everything we have written above. Please also check our website and international media to get a good overview of Too Good To Go.

Submit your CV/Cover Letter in English.

Please note that we only accept applications coming through our platform. No CV or Cover Letter will be accepted by email or LinkedIn direct messaging.

 
Job Ref: #LI-CT1

A Movement for Everyone
We want to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together. With that mission, it’s only natural that we want to build a diverse and inclusive team of highly capable individuals who are passionate about doing things in a better way. We strongly believe we all excel and are more creative when we’re allowed to be ourselves, and we’re committed to a culture where all of us belong.
We are an equal opportunity employer and all employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need. If you need reasonable accommodation at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.

About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the team

You'll be part of a team that is passionate about helping ambitious businesses scale globally. We're collaborative, innovative, and deeply embedded in the UK startup ecosystem. Our team values learning, growth, and making a real impact - both for our customers and for each other. This is a place where you'll be empowered to take ownership, build relationships, and help shape the future of fintech in the UK.

What you'll do

As an Account Executive, Startups, you'll play a pivotal role in making Airwallex the finance stack of choice for the next generation of UK startups. You'll work closely with our VC and Community partnerships team to engage Seed-Series A startups, proactively source and outbound high-potential businesses, and ensure a seamless onboarding experience. You'll educate founders on our full product suite, enabling them to build their billing engine from scratch on the Airwallex platform. You'll also embed Airwallex in the startup community by attending events, hosting roundtables, and building our brand across the ecosystem.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full sales cycle for early-stage startups, from prospecting and qualification to close and onboarding

  • Work closely with the VC Partnerships team to access and engage the next wave of high-growth startups, mapping out the startup ecosysetem strategically including accelerators, incubators, founder communities, angel investment communities, PortCos of key venture funds

  • Proactively source and outbound to Seed/Series A businesses to supplement top-down partnership efforts, identifying key PortCos from our partner funds that we could work with and support

  • Ensure a seamless, founder-friendly onboarding experience, guiding startups through KYC, product setup, and first transactions

  • Educate customers on the benefits of Airwallex's full product suite, helping them build scalable finance operations from day one. Offer monthly office hours for Airwallex for startup companies to book time in to learn more about the product. Identify where we are winning and areas of development. Be data led by collating feedback on which of our competitors are winning within the startup ecosystem and why

  • Actively embed Airwallex in the UK startup community: attend and speak at events, build relationships with founders and ecosystem partners, as well as contributing to startup content e.g. newsletter new product releases, key Airwallex startup news, VC spotlights

  • Be a visible advocate for Airwallex, sharing insights and success stories to build our brand and credibility in the startup ecosystem

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, marketing and customer success to ensure startups get maximum value from Airwallex

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2+ years of sales experience in a B2B SaaS, Fintech or payments environment, in a sales development, account executive or account management role

  • Track record of meeting or exceeding targets

  • Demonstrated ability across the sales cycle - from self-sourced prospecting to close and onboarding

  • Genuine affinity and/or experience in the startup ecosystem. Familiarity with the UK startup landscape - key VCs, accelerators, incubators, investor/angel communities

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills - you're articulate, professional and equally comfortable presenting to a room of founders as you are doing a 1:1 deep dive with a Finance Lead over coffee

  • Capable of leading fast, frictionless deals via credible, strategic, visionary conversations with senior founders

  • Confident working in an event-driven activation model - attending and speaking at various events, conferences, dinners

  • Proficient in CRM and outreach tooling, and structured pipeline management

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in fintech, payments, or financial services with an understanding of products such as global accounts, payment acceptance, FX, card issuing, or spend management.

  • Hands-on exposure to AI tools and agentic workflows (e.g. Claude, Cursor, or similar), or a track record of being an early adopter who can make new technology tangible for non-technical audiences.

  • Experience managing a backbook or portfolio of accounts alongside new business responsibilities, with demonstrated ability to retain and grow existing customers.

  • A visible personal presence in the startup community — whether through event attendance, LinkedIn activity, community involvement, or existing relationships with founders and investors.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset — prior founder experience or side-project background is a genuine plus, as it deepens your empathy for the customers we serve.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. title: Senior Talent Attraction Specialist (m/f/d)
description:
Mission Brief 

As we scale to reach orbit, we are looking for a Senior Talent Attraction Specialist to build and own some of the most high-leverage, relationship-driven parts of our recruiting function.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments and loves the hunt — bringing proven recruiting expertise to shape how we hire and grow. You will work closely with hiring managers and our leadership team on complex, high-impact roles, coach other recruiters on the team, and take ownership of some of our most business-critical hiring processes from day one.

Your Role in Our Space Mission: 

  • Act as a trusted recruiting advisor to hiring managers and our leadership team, anticipating hiring needs and independently choosing the right approach for complex or cross-functional roles
  • Bring market insights and recruiting expertise to the table to influence hiring decisions, and build long-term stakeholder relationships across the business
  • Design and drive sourcing strategies for hard-to-fill or high-impact roles, building and continuously improving talent pipelines
  • Act as a first point of contact and senior brand ambassador for Isar Aerospace, representing the company confidently in complex or high-stakes candidate conversations
  • Own multiple concurrent and complex recruitment processes, anticipating bottlenecks and adjusting priorities independently to deliver results
  • Train and coach interviewers on structured hiring techniques
  • Own recruiting KPIs for your area, using data to identify process improvements and share insights with the team

Qualification Checklist 

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in business, psychology, HR, or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including experience in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
  • Track record of independently managing complex or cross-functional hiring processes and influencing hiring decisions at the stakeholder level
  • Experience designing sourcing strategies and coaching or mentoring others

title: Director Production Engineering (m/f/d)
description:
Mission Brief 

As Director of Production Engineering, you are accountable for the end-to-end production engineering capability across all manufacturing operations. Your mission is to industrialize development outputs into repeatable, scalable, and compliant serial production, ensuring manufacturing readiness, process stability, quality, cost efficiency, and on-time delivery. You lead the team that converts early procedures into robust production standards, embeds them in PLM/MES systems, and drives continuous improvement across the factory.

You act as the primary interface between Engineering (design & development) and Manufacturing (production & operations)—ensuring requirements, procedures, tooling, documentation, test strategies, and digital manufacturing infrastructure are aligned for high-rate, high-quality execution. 

Your Role in Our Space Mission: 

1) Production engineering strategy & leadership

  • Define and execute the production engineering roadmap, including industrialization strategy, standardization, and scalability for serial production.
  • Lead and develop a team of production/process/manufacturing engineers; set goals, coaching plans, hiring needs, and performance standards.
  • Establish clear governance for process ownership, engineering change implementation, and cross-functional decision-making.

2) Assembly, integration & test (AIT) process ownership

  • Own manufacturing process definition across:
    • Assembly: mechanical/electrical build procedures, torque specs, critical process parameters, work instructions.
    • Integration: subsystem integration strategy (e.g., avionics, propulsion, communications), sequencing, interfaces, and acceptance criteria.
    • Testing: functional, subsystem, and system-level test strategy; test readiness, execution plans, and troubleshooting methodology.
  • Ensure processes are repeatable, auditable, and optimized for safety, throughput, and quality.

3) Industrialization & manufacturing readiness (NPI / transfer to production)

  • Coordinate with development teams to receive initial procedures and convert them into production-ready standards (control plans, critical-to-quality characteristics where relevant).
  • Drive manufacturing readiness reviews, line readiness, and process qualification for new products, variants, or upgrades.
  • Lead the “first builds”/pilot runs, capturing learnings and stabilizing procedures for volume execution.

4) Digital manufacturing (PLM/MES) & configuration control

  • Own the production engineering contribution to PLM/MES:
    • Translate procedures into structured digital work instructions.
    • Ensure traceability, configuration control, and alignment of as-built data.
  • Oversee creation and maintenance of:
    • mBOM (Manufacturing Bill of Materials)
    • BOP (Bill of Process)
    • Routings, work centers, and data collection points for quality and traceability.
  • Ensure engineering changes are implemented cleanly and quickly, with minimal disruption to production.

5) Documentation, compliance & quality partnership

  • Ensure complete, consistent documentation for:
    • Work instructions, process specifications, test reports, NCRs (non-conformance reports), deviations/waivers, and as-built configurations.
  • Partner with Quality to build robust nonconformance management and corrective action systems (root cause, containment, RCCA & PA).
  • Ensure processes meet applicable regulatory, customer, and internal compliance requirements.

6) Cross-functional execution & production support

  • Serve as senior escalation point for technical blockers in production: diagnose recurring issues, direct corrective actions, and prevent reoccurrence.
  • Align with Supply Chain and Operations on:
    • Kitting strategy, material availability, critical path timelines, and constraint removal.
  • Coordinate engineering support coverage and readiness for shifts, rate increases, and critical campaigns.

7) Continuous improvement, cost & throughput

  • Support Lean Team on Lean/CI initiatives to improve:
    • Yield, cycle time, takt adherence, OEE, scrap/rework reduction, and labor efficiency.
  • Establish KPIs and operating mechanisms (tier meetings, weekly business reviews) to track and improve production engineering performance.
  • Build business cases for capital investments (test equipment, tooling, automation) and manage the budget for your scope.

8) Capability building: training & knowledge management

  • Build a strong knowledge-transfer system between engineers and technicians:
    • Training plans, certification matrices, standardized visual work instructions, and lessons-learned libraries.
  • Ensure procedures are systematically categorized, version-controlled, and easily accessible to production teams.

Success measures (typical KPIs)

  • Improved first-pass yield, reduced NCR rate, reduced rework hours
  • Reduced cycle time and improved on-time delivery
  • Faster and cleaner engineering change implementation
  • Increased process stability (fewer repeat issues, fewer line stops)
  • Strong audit outcomes and complete traceability / as-built compliance
  • High team engagement, retention, and capability maturity

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Aerospace, Automotive, Industrial Engineering, or similar.
  • Significant experience in production/manufacturing engineering, industrialization, manufacturing operations—ideally across complex electromechanical systems.
  • Proven leadership experience managing teams and cross-functional stakeholders.

title: Senior Product Manager (f/m/x)
description: Your Mission This is a company built for growth, not comfort. When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. We build high-performing consumer products in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming, leading one of its largest innovations, a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences. Senior Product Manager (f/m/x) isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform. Product at exmox means understanding the bigger business picture, considering cross-functional impact across Engineering, Data, Marketing, and Operations, and turning strategy into product decisions that create real value, knowing every change you ship affects millions of users. At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in. If you're energized by dynamic markets, complex products, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you. What You’ll Own: Own one of exmox's highest-impact product domains end-to-end, shaping the reward economy through payout thresholds, tiering, bonuses, promotions, and other key levers that drive profitability. Drive activation, retention, and long-term engagement through onboarding experiences, streaks, quests, progression systems, reactivation flows, and other lifecycle initiatives. Take new growth opportunities from first hypothesis to go/no-go decision, across product, market expansion, partnerships, and distribution. Lead a high-quality experimentation process by defining hypotheses, designing statistically sound A/B tests, interpreting results, and making data-driven product decisions. Partner closely with your dedicated Data Analyst to uncover opportunities, validate assumptions, and continuously improve product performance. Work with Engineering, Design, Commercial, User Acquisition, Customer Support, Fraud, and Leadership to align priorities and deliver impactful product improvements. Represent your product domain directly to leadership, using data, customer insights, and business context to influence strategic decisions. What Success Looks Like: You take ownership quickly: Within your first months, you've become the trusted owner of a critical product domain, confidently driving priorities, making decisions, and reducing dependency on leadership. Growth metrics measurably improve: Your product strategy and experimentation drive meaningful improvements in activation, retention, and long-term user profitability. Product decisions are driven by data: Experiments, user insights, and product analytics provide clear evidence to prioritize opportunities, validate ideas, and confidently decide what to scale - or stop. Cross-functional teams are aligned around outcomes: You partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Commercial, and User Acquisition to deliver product improvements that balance user value with business impact. You turn ambitious ideas into scalable growth: Through structured experimentation, clear prioritization, and continuous optimization, you build product experiences that become repeatable growth levers for the business. You outgrow the role: We are hiring for the ceiling, not just the opening. This role is scoped to grow - mentoring other product managers first, and leading a product team as we scale, if that is the direction you want to take. What You Bring Experienced: You bring 5+ years of Product Management experience in consumer-facing digital products, ideally within mobile apps, gaming, marketplaces, subscriptions, ad-tech, fintech, or other high-growth B2C businesses. You have owned consumer product at scale - hundreds of thousands of monthly active users or more. Business-Oriented: You understand that product decisions are business decisions. You're comfortable balancing user needs, commercial objectives, and technical constraints to maximize long-term value. Fluent in Incentives: You have a real feel for why people come back and what makes a reward feel worth the effort. You have designed incentive, reward or progression mechanics and calibrated them so they motivate without eroding margin. Experimentation-Driven: You have extensive experience running A/B tests, defining hypotheses, interpreting data, and making evidence-based product decisions. Statistical thinking comes naturally to you. Data-Literate: You're comfortable working with product metrics and collaborating closely with analysts to uncover insights, measure success, and prioritize opportunities. Strategic & Hands-on: You enjoy defining product strategy while remaining deeply involved in execution - from writing specifications and refining solutions to reviewing experiment results and driving delivery. Collaborative: You build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Marketing, Commercial, and Leadership, bringing people together around clear product goals. Intellectually Honest: You're comfortable working in ambiguity, take ownership without waiting for direction, and thrive in fast-moving environments where priorities evolve quickly. You also kill your own ideas when the data says so - being wrong early is cheaper than being right late. How We Win Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford. Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail. See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved. Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes. Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together. Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday! title: DevOps Engineer AWS & Kubernetes, Junior/Intermediate (m/w/d)
description: Remote (Deutschland) · Angestellte/r · DevOps / Cloud DevOps Engineer AWS & Kubernetes, Junior/Intermediate (m/w/d), Remote, Vollzeit, ab Anfang September. Für unser sympathisches Team suchen wir deutschsprachige DevOps Engineers (m/w/d) auf Junior- oder Intermediate-Level, die in unserem Kundenprojekt den Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung einer geschäftskritischen Plattform in der AWS Cloud mittragen. New Monday ist eine Digitalagentur aus Berlin, die zu 100% remote arbeitet. Zu unseren Kunden zählen namhafte Konzerne wie Atruvia, DAK, SAP, Lufthansa uvm. genau wie moderne Start-Ups wie NUMA Stays. Als Arbeitgeber zeichnen wir uns vor allem durch flache Hierarchien, unser agiles Mindset und einen New Work Approach aus. Alle unsere New Monday Team Members arbeiten zu 100% remote (Home Office), sind dank unserer positiven Remote Culture aber trotzdem miteinander verbunden (erfahre mehr darüber im Abschnitt "Benefits"). Zum Projekt: Die Anwendung ist die zentrale Plattform für die Planung und Steuerung der Abläufe in den 10 Werken eines großen deutschen Mobilitätskonzerns. Aktuell wird ein DevOps-Team aufgebaut, bestehend aus den vorhandenen Betriebsspezialisten und zentralen Entwicklern der drei Entwicklungsteams, um Weiterentwicklung und Betrieb langfristig sicherzustellen. Die Anwendung läuft derzeit im SLA Bronze; ab Ende des zweiten Quartals 2027 soll SLA Gold möglich sein, da dann die Disposition in den Betrieb geht. Die Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit und Betriebsstabilität steigen also messbar, und genau daran arbeitest du mit. Aufgaben Betrieb, Überwachung und technische Betreuung der produktiven Anwendung und der zugehörigen Infrastruktur in der AWS Cloud, inklusive Analyse und Bearbeitung auftretender Fehler und Störungen. Bearbeitung von Security Findings sowie Durchführung erforderlicher Patch- und Aktualisierungsmaßnahmen. Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung der automatisierten Bereitstellung und Konfiguration der Umgebungen mit Terraform bzw. OpenTofu. Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung der Kubernetes-Cluster und der zugehörigen Infrastrukturkonfigurationen, inklusive Optimierung des automatisierten Node-Scalings mit Karpenter. Unterstützung bei Bereitstellung und Deployment containerisierter Anwendungen auf Basis von Docker, Helm und Flux sowie Analyse und Behebung von Problemen in Deployments und Release-Prozessen. Betreuung und Konfiguration von AWS IAM-Rollen und Berechtigungen sowie Einrichtung und Verwaltung von Secrets und Verschlüsselung mit AWS Secrets Manager und AWS KMS. Unterstützung bei der Anbindung und Konfiguration von PostgreSQL-Datenbanken auf Basis von AWS RDS. Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung der Monitoring- und Logging-Lösungen auf Basis von Grafana und OpenSearch. Betreuung und Konfiguration der Kafka-Infrastruktur auf Basis von Amazon MSK Serverless. Weiterentwicklung automatisierter Dependency- und Update-Prozesse mit Renovate. Entwicklung, Anpassung und Betreuung von AWS-Lambda-Funktionen auf Basis von Python. Konsolidierung und technische Weiterentwicklung der bestehenden Infrastruktur sowie Analyse technischer Probleme rund um Infrastruktur, Deployment, IAM, Datenbankanbindungen und Secrets. Erstellung und Pflege technischer Betriebsdokumentation, insbesondere Runbooks, Betriebsprozesse und Handlungsanweisungen. Mitwirkung bei der Standardisierung und Automatisierung wiederkehrender Betriebsabläufe und bei der Vorbereitung der Anwendung auf erhöhte Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit und Betriebsstabilität. Qualifikation Must-have: Erfahrung im operativen Betrieb produktiver IT-Anwendungen in Cloud-Infrastrukturen. Erfahrung in der Konfiguration und Administration von AWS-Cloud-Infrastrukturen. Erfahrung mit Kubernetes als Containerplattform zur Bereitstellung und Verwaltung containerisierter Anwendungen. Infrastructure as Code mit Terraform oder OpenTofu. Erfahrung im Betrieb geschäftskritischer Anwendungen mit etablierten Incident-Management-Prozessen. Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (Projektsprache ist Deutsch). Verfügbarkeit ab Anfang September. Nice-to-have: Erfahrung mit Docker, Helm und GitOps-Ansätzen. Monitoring, Logging und technische Fehleranalyse. AWS Cloud Security, z. B. IAM, Secrets, Verschlüsselung. Erfahrung im IT-Betriebsmanagement. Deployment- und Release-Automatisierung. Benefits Tolle Leute, super Atmosphäre, dynamisches Team, agile Arbeitsweise Sweet Spot zwischen Corporate-Alltag und kreativem Agenturleben: Bei uns musst du nicht zwischen hunderten Projekten gleichzeitig jonglieren, sondern bist immer nur für ein einzelnes Projekt eingeteilt. Die Möglichkeit, deutschlandweit ortsunabhängig zu arbeiten, wo immer du möchtest (100% Home Office) sowie im Rahmen der rechtlichen Vorgaben zeitweise auch im EU-Ausland Monatliches Budget für Treffen vor Ort mit deinen Kolleg:innen, das du beliebig einsetzen kannst (Teamtage im Co-Working-Space aber genauso auch einfach für den gemeinsamen Lunch, Dinner, After-Work-Drinks etc.) Regelmäßige digitale Teamabende und andere coole digitale Events Treffen vor Ort mit dem ganzen Team in unserem inoffiziellen Hub Berlin ein- bis zweimal pro Jahr Wöchentliche Learning Sessions im Team und weitere Möglichkeiten zu deiner persönlichen und beruflichen Entwicklung (Weiterbildungen, Erwerb von Zertifikaten etc.) Eigenständiges, flexibles Arbeiten ohne Micromanagement Erstes Kennenlernen Du lernst unsere Arbeitsweise und Philosophie kennen. Du hast die Gelegenheit, dich vorzustellen. Wir beantworten alle deine Fragen in entspannter Atmosphäre. Vorstellungsgespräch mit unseren Co-Foundern Laura Nielsen und Dario Zampetti Ausführlicheres Kennenlernen. Gelegenheit zu gegenseitigen Fragen. Follow-Up Hierzu erhältst du vorab eine kleine technische Challenge, in der du zeigen kannst, wie du an Aufgaben herangehst. Die Ergebnisse besprechen wir gemeinsam im Follow-Up. Du hast anschließend die Möglichkeit, ein Gespräch unter vier Augen mit einem deiner zukünftigen Kolleg:innen zu führen und in vertrauensvoller Atmosphäre all das zu fragen, was dir vielleicht noch auf der Seele brennt. Also los geht's! Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung. Um es einfach zu halten, verzichten wir gerne auf ein Anschreiben. Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf, auch wenn du das Gefühl hast, nicht 100 % der Anforderungen zu erfüllen. New Monday fördert aktiv die Gleichstellung aller Beschäftigten. Wir begrüßen daher alle Bewerber:innen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, ethnischer, kultureller und sozialer Herkunft, Alter, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung sowie sexueller Identität der Person. Menschen mit Schwerbehinderung werden bei gleicher Eignung unter Berücksichtigung aller Umstände des Einzelfalls bevorzugt. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Ecommerce Executive | Lookfantastic
description:
About THG 

We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition. 

Our portfolio of leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition. 

From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.  

With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for? 

Life at THG Beauty 

We know that beauty isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our portfolio of leading retailers and iconic beauty brands caters to everyone, everywhere, empowering customers all over the world to look and feel fantastic.

By combining our portfolio of owned brands inclusive of ESPA, Ameliorate and Christophe Robin, with a marketplace for over 1,300 third-party beauty brands through online retail sites LOOKFANTASTIC, Cult Beauty, and Dermstore, THG Beauty's ambition is to be the global digital partner of choice across the beauty industry, supporting the channel shift to online.

THG Beauty’s breadth of relationships is unique to the beauty market; it engages with brands as a retailer, a brand owner, and a product developer and manufacturer, making it the industry’s digital strategic leader. 

 Why be a Senior Ecommerce Executive at THG Beauty? 

Operates at a more senior level than Ecommerce Executive, owning relationships and providing direction. Thorough skills across data analysis, SQL and manipulating data. Understands the 'why' behind actions, not just the fact we are actioning them.

As Senior Ecommerce Executive you’ll:  

  • Systems: lead training and learning on TeePee, Superset, Tableau, ContentSquare, Campaign Manager and GA; manipulate SQL independently.
  • Offers: independently set up all offer types; act as a point of contact for other team members requiring support.
  • KPIs: proactively suggest and take actions to influence Revenue, GP, AOV, CVR & Traffic.
  • Site Execution: set an example in the use of systems to understand and enhance the customer journey from a trade perspective; competently use CSQ (Zoning, Journey, Workspace analysis).
  • GP: own the 'why' behind trade actions; drive GP-focused decisions with greater autonomy.
  • Cross channel/function collaboration: drive trading actions with greater autonomy. Ownership of multiple categories/channels.
  • Change Management: understand business needs and priorities; help lead the redistribution of workload across the team to hit deadlines.
  • Ownerships: thorough understanding of individual and team roles; drive own areas and support others with theirs.
  • Knowledge Sharing: set an example in how knowledge and insight is shared across and outside the team 

What skills and experience do I need for this role? 

  • Prioritisation: independently prioritise workload; support team members to do the same.
  • Organisation: independently manage own workload; support others to organise theirs.
  • Collaboration: lead collaboration across and outside the team; drive process improvements.
  • Communication: strong written/verbal communication, flexed for the audience and division.
  • Active Listening: lead by example in meetings.
  • Growth Mindset: proactively identify and close gaps in own knowledge.
  • Accountability: strong attention to detail in own work.
  • Role Model: demonstrate leadership across the Executive level within the team.

What’s in it for me? 

Career Development 

  • Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by our in-house L&D team. 
  • Continued development through our upskilling programme that is delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider. 

Enhanced Leave 

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays. 
  • Don’t want to work on your birthday? We don’t either! Enjoy your day off on us! 
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, depending on length of service.  
  • Up to 10 days compassionate leave. 
  • Buy back up to 3 days each year. 
  • Unlock 2 days volunteer leave after 12-months. 

Wellbeing Support 

  • Access face-to-face and virtual appointments with our in-house GP.
     
  • Access our 247 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) which is provided by Bupa.  
  • State-of-the-art on-site gym. 
  • Access to our on-site physio. 

Other Perks 

  • Save up to 12% on the cost of personal tech through our salary sacrifice scheme. 
  • Subsidised bus pass from Manchester City Centre to our ICON office.  
  • Up to 50% staff discount on THG brands. 

  • On-site staff shop.
     
  • Know someone who would be perfect for THG? Refer them and get up to £1000 when they pass their probation. 
  • Anniversary gifts when you hit 5 and 10 years of service. 

THG is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability.

THG is committed to creating a diverse & inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community.

Because of the high volumes of applications our opportunities attract, it sometimes takes us time to review and consider them all. We endeavour to respond to every application we receive within 14 days. If you haven't heard from us within that time frame or should you have any specific questions about this or other applications for positions at THG please contact one of our Talent team to discuss further.

Superior writing skills, the ability to time manage and meet deadlines, and a thorough working knowledge of contemporary art are required.
